pullRequests.title: feat: v2 derived content — re-derived from code + issues + PRs + commits
pullRequests.body: Replaces all hand-authored content with machine-derived content using the enriched derivation pipeline. ## Pipeline \\\ generate-manifest → catalogue.json → enrich-context.js → catalogue-enriched.json → kb-writer → content/*.md \\\ ## Quality comparison | Metric | Baseline | Derived v2 | |--------|----------|------------| | Nodes | 45 | 53 | | Avg chars/node | 3,795 | 3,969 | | Avg links/node | 6.0 | 14.9 | | H2 sections | Some | All | | Code examples | Few | All | | Issue/PR refs | None | Throughout | ## What's new - \scripts/enrich-context.js\ — cross-references manifest data per catalogue node - \content/catalogue-enriched.json\ — catalogue with issue/PR/commit context - 53 content files with \derived: true\ flag, structured sections, code examples - Validated: 160 unit tests ✅, graph validation ✅, Playwright visual check ✅ ---

pullRequests.title: feat: Content Derivation Engine — graph-aware content generation pipeline
pullRequests.body: ## What Infrastructure to derive kbexplorer content from systems of record (source files, git, issues) instead of hand-authoring everything. Goal: delete \content/\ and re-derive it, getting something equal or better. ### Graph constraints enforced - ≤50 visible nodes per view, ≤100 edges, ≤8 clusters - Every node ≤3 hops from hub, no orphans, ≥2 links per node ### New files **Agents:** - \.github/agents/kb-architect.md\ — generates graph catalogues (nodes + clusters + edge hints) not linear TOCs - \.github/agents/kb-writer.md\ — generates inline-linked graph content with \derived: true\ flag **Scripts:** - \kbx graph assess\ — evaluates content against graph readability constraints (scores + suggestions) - \scripts/derive-content.js\ — lists catalogue nodes needing content generation - \scripts/compare-content.js\ — diffs catalogue vs existing content (coverage, drift, orphans) **Types:** - \KBNode.derived\ boolean field - \NodeSource: { type: 'derived', generator: string }\ variant - Nodemap nodes auto-tagged \derived: true\ **Content:** - \content/catalogue.json\ — 37-node graph catalogue for this repo ### npm scripts - \ pm run assess\ — graph quality assessment - \ pm run derive\ — list nodes needing generation - \ pm run compare\ — catalogue vs content diff ### Next steps (not in this PR) - Worktree experiment: delete content/, run derivation, compare results - \knowledge/\ directory for non-derivable info (design decisions, context) ---

pullRequests.title: feat: Digital Twin Universe — GitHub API twin for testing
pullRequests.body: ## What Adds a complete DTU (Digital Twin Universe) for GitHub API interactions, eliminating rate limiting and flakiness from development and testing. ### twins/github/ - **server.js** — zero-dependency HTTP server mimicking api.github.com - **capture.js** — snapshot real API responses into fixtures - **gh-mock.js** — drop-in gh CLI replacement - **fixtures/** — canned responses (139 tree, 65 issues, 25 PRs, 50 commits) - **scenarios/** — holdout validation (rate-limit, 304/ETag, 404, empty-repo, slow) ### Infrastructure - \src/api/github.ts\ — \VITE_GH_API_BASE\ env var for configurable API base URL - \DTU.md\ — philosophy and holdout rules - \AGENTS.md\ — validation strategy section ## How to use \\\ ash node twins/github/server.js # Start twin on :3456 VITE_GH_API_BASE=http://localhost:3456 npm run dev # Use twin in dev \\\ Closes #49 ---

pullRequests.title: Improve agentic readiness
pullRequests.body: ## Changes Addresses agentic readiness gaps identified by [microsoft/agentrc](https://github.com/microsoft/agentrc) assessment. ### Added - `.editorconfig` — consistent code formatting - `.github/CODEOWNERS` — security governance - `.github/dependabot.yml` — automated dependency updates - `.github/copilot-instructions.md` — AI agent instructions - `AGENTS.md` — agent behavior, branch protection rules, issue workflow, verification policy - `CONTRIBUTING.md` — contribution guidelines - `.env.example` — environment variable template - Formatter/linter configuration (ruff.toml, .prettierrc, etc.) - CI workflow (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) Closes #49 ---

pullRequests.title: feat: Replace GitHub API with local data for self-exploration
pullRequests.body: refs #29 ## Summary Adds manifest-only local mode that eliminates all GitHub API calls at runtime for self-exploration. A pre-build script generates `src/generated/repo-manifest.json` containing everything the app needs. ## What's included **Pre-build manifest** (`scripts/generate-manifest.js`): - Walks local file system for tree structure - Reads README.md, content/*.md, config.yaml from disk - Fetches issues/PRs via `gh` CLI (best-effort, graceful degradation) - Fetches recent commits via `git log` - Host-aware for submodule mode **Local loader** (`src/engine/local-loader.ts`): - Imports manifest and produces same KBNode[]/KBConfig as API loaders - Reuses existing parseMarkdownFile, treeToNodes, issueToNode - Mode detection: `VITE_KB_LOCAL=true` or manifest presence **Integration**: - `useKnowledgeBase` hook routes to local or remote loaders - `resolveImageUrl` respects `BASE_URL` in local mode - Vite plugin auto-generates manifest on dev/build start - `prebuild` script added to package.json build pipeline ## Test results - **36 unit tests passing** (manifest script + parser exports) - **E2E verified with Playwright**: 116 nodes, 219 edges, 16 clusters loaded from local manifest with zero API calls - Issues, PRs, commits, authored content, README all render correctly ## How to test ```bash # Generate manifest and run dev server in local mode VITE_KB_LOCAL=true npm run dev # Or on Windows PowerShell: $env:VITE_KB_LOCAL = 'true'; npm run dev ``` ---

pullRequests.title: feat: sepia reading theme via custom Fluent theme
pullRequests.body: Adds a warm sepia reading theme built on Fluent 2 using createLightTheme() with a custom amber brand ramp. Overrides neutral background/card/stroke/foreground tokens for a paper-like reading experience. Three-way toggle: dark ↔ light ↔ sepia. ---

pullRequests.body: Updates README to reflect the Fluent 2 visual refresh: - Fonts: Segoe UI + Cascadia Code (replaces Instrument Serif, General Sans, JetBrains Mono) - Visual identity: Fluent icons from @fluentui/react-icons - Themes: dark/light only (sepia dropped) - Dependencies: added @fluentui/react-components and @fluentui/react-icons - Repo-aware mode: PRs filtered out, only issues/README/dirs become nodes ---

pullRequests.title: feat: Fluent 2 overview, loading/error, and visual system
pullRequests.body: ## Changes - **OverviewView**: Replaced custom HTML/CSS with Fluent Card, Badge, CounterBadge, Title1, Subtitle2, makeStyles grid layout - **LoadingScreen**: Fluent Spinner + Body1 (removed custom spinner CSS/keyframes) - **ErrorScreen**: Fluent MessageBar + Button (removed custom error styles) - **NodeVisual/visuals.css**: Fluent shape tokens (borderRadiusMedium, borderRadiusCircular) and color tokens (colorNeutralBackground3, colorNeutralForeground2, colorNeutralStroke2, colorNeutralBackground1) - **overview.css**: Stripped all legacy classes — styles now live in makeStyles ---

pullRequests.title: fix: font sizer, minimap layout, and constellation overlay
pullRequests.body: Fixes four issues: 1. **Font sizer broken** — .kb-prose was hardcoding font-size: 1.05rem, ignoring the CSS variable 2. **Width sizer partly broken** — now properly consumed 3. **Minimap layout wrong** — was using naive circular layout, now uses force-directed positions from a temp vis-network 4. **Minimap click wrong** — was navigating to #/graph, now expands a constellation overlay (like Mukaase) Also improved full-page graph readability: more spacing, font stroke on labels. ---

pullRequests.title: feat: responsive layout + example issues for default experience
pullRequests.body: ## Summary Responsive CSS audit across all views plus 8 example GitHub issues to enrich the default repo-aware experience. ### Responsive Layout (Task 1) - **Breakpoints**: Desktop (>1024px), Tablet (768–1024px), Mobile (<768px) - **Overview**: Card grid 3→2→1 columns with consistent breakpoints - **Reading**: Connections sidebar on desktop, stacked below on tablet/mobile. Prose respects `--prose-max-width` variable. - **Graph**: Legend repositions to bottom-center on mobile - **HUD**: Three-panel on desktop, no minimap on tablet, collapsed 60px on mobile (center nav only) - **Cross-cutting**: `responsive.css` handles hero sizing and overflow prevention on mobile ### Example Content (Task 2) Created 8 issues (#9–#14, #16–#17) describing kbexplorer's own architecture: - Visual Identity System, Constellation Graph, HUD, GitHub API mode - Theme System, Phase 2 Copilot vision, Keyboard navigation, Authored mode - Issues cross-reference each other to create a rich graph with meaningful connections ---

pullRequests.title: feat: Azure Static Web Apps deployment + comprehensive README
pullRequests.body: ## Changes - **Azure Static Web Apps workflow** — GitHub Actions CI/CD that builds and deploys on push to main, creates staging environments for PRs, and cleans up on PR close - **SPA routing config** — \staticwebapp.config.json\ rewrites all paths to \index.html\ (excluding static assets) - **Comprehensive README** — full documentation covering features, content modes, visual identity system, configuration, content authoring, deployment, and architecture Closes azure-deploy and documentation tasks. ---

pullRequests.title: feat: theme system, keyboard navigation, and HUD
pullRequests.body: ## Summary Three cross-cutting features for kbexplorer: ### 1. Theme System (\src/hooks/useTheme.ts\) - Dark/light/sepia switching with CSS variables - Persisted in localStorage (\kbe-theme\) - Body class applied: \ heme-light\, \ heme-sepia\ (dark is default/no class) ### 2. Keyboard Navigation (\src/hooks/useKeyboardNav.ts\) - \ \ → cycle theme - \/\ → overview, \g\ → graph, \Escape\ → back - \←/→\ → prev/next node in reading view - Ignores input when focused on form elements ### 3. HUD (\src/components/HUD.tsx\ + \src/styles/hud.css\) - Fixed 170px bottom bar with three panels - **Left**: minimap canvas with constellation dots - **Center**: navigation (MAP button, prev/next, current node info, related nodes strip) - **Right**: reading tools (theme radio buttons, font size slider, column width slider) - Hidden on graph view, collapses to 60px on mobile (<768px) - Font size and column width persisted in localStorage ### Files Changed - \src/hooks/useTheme.ts\ — new - \src/hooks/useKeyboardNav.ts\ — new - \src/components/HUD.tsx\ — new - \src/styles/hud.css\ — new - \src/index.css\ — added light/sepia theme variables - \src/App.tsx\ — integrated hooks and HUD component ---

pullRequests.title: feat: reading view with prose, connections, and navigation
pullRequests.body: ## Reading View Implements the detail panel shown when navigating to \#/node/{id}\. ### What's included - **ReadingView component** (\src/views/ReadingView.tsx\) - Hero/sprite/emoji header based on visual mode - Markdown prose rendered via \.kb-prose\ styles - Connected nodes sidebar (desktop) / section (mobile) - Prev/next navigation within same cluster - Not-found state with back link - **Reading styles** (\src/styles/reading.css\) - Full prose typography (headings, code, blockquotes, tables, lists, links, hr) - Connection cards with cluster pills - Responsive layout: sidebar at 1024px+, stacked below 768px - Prev/next footer navigation - **App.tsx** — Wired \/node/:id\ route to ReadingView via ReadingRoute wrapper ---

pullRequests.title: feat: constellation graph view with vis-network
pullRequests.body: ## Summary Full-viewport interactive graph visualization at \#/graph\ using vis-network. ### Changes - **GraphView component** (\src/views/GraphView.tsx\): vis-network constellation with forceAtlas2Based physics, node sizing by degree, cluster-colored nodes via \getVisNodeConfig\ - **Cluster legend**: bottom-left overlay with click-to-filter (dims non-matching nodes) - **Navigation**: node click → \#/node/{id}\, back button → \#/\ - **Tooltips**: node hover shows title + connection count, edge hover shows description - **Styling** (\src/styles/graph.css\): dark theme, fixed full-viewport canvas, glassmorphic overlays - **App.tsx**: wired GraphView into the \/graph\ route Closes #5 ---

pullRequests.title: feat: overview card grid + loading/error states
pullRequests.body: ## Changes - **OverviewView** (\src/views/OverviewView.tsx\): Card grid landing page grouped by cluster with NodeVisual, connection counts, cluster pills, and hover effects (border glow + lift). Responsive 3→2→1 column layout. - **LoadingScreen** (\src/components/LoadingScreen.tsx\): Centered spinner + text + 6 skeleton card placeholders with pulse animation. - **ErrorScreen** (\src/components/ErrorScreen.tsx\): Warning icon + error message + retry button + rate limit reset detection. - **App.tsx**: Replaced inline loading/error JSX and placeholder overview with new components. Added overview.css import. - **overview.css**: All styles for overview grid, loading screen, and error screen using CSS variables from index.css. ---

pullRequests.title: feat: core modules — GitHub client, parser, graph engine, visual system
pullRequests.body: Implements the foundational runtime modules for kbexplorer. ## Modules | Module | Path | Purpose | |--------|------|---------| | GitHub client | src/api/github.ts | Fetch files, trees, issues, PRs with caching + rate limits | | Content parser | src/engine/parser.ts | Authored (frontmatter+markdown) + repo-aware (issues/PRs/README) | | Graph engine | src/engine/graph.ts | Builds edges, computes related nodes (max 8, by degree) | | Visual system | src/components/NodeVisual.tsx | 7 surfaces × 4 modes (sprites/heroes/emoji/none) | | KB hook | src/hooks/useKnowledgeBase.ts | Ties API + parser + graph into one loading hook | | Styles | src/styles/visuals.css | Hero overlay, blur bg, circular crops, animations | ## Default experience App loads in repo-aware mode, fetches content from anokye-labs/kbexplorer via GitHub API, and renders a node list. Closes #3 ---

pullRequests.title: feat: scaffold Vite + React + TypeScript project
pullRequests.body: Scaffolds the kbexplorer repo with Vite + React 19 + TypeScript (strict mode). ## What - Vite + React 19 + TypeScript project scaffold - Core dependencies: react-router-dom, vis-network, vis-data, gray-matter, marked, yaml, @octokit/rest - Type definitions: KBNode, KBGraph, KBConfig, VisualMode, NodeSource - Default config for repo-aware mode (explores anokye-labs/kbexplorer itself) - Dark theme base CSS with design tokens (Instrument Serif / General Sans / JetBrains Mono) - Clean App shell with HashRouter (overview, graph, reading routes) - MIT license, README Closes #1 ---
